description: Reverse-ETL / audience activation: upload an upstream DataFrame into a TikTok Custom Audience via the two-stage file-upload + update flow (dmp/custom_audience/file/upload then dmp/custom_audience/update). One file is uploaded per identifier type present in fields_map. Identifiers are SHA-256 hashed before upload. Supports 'add' (APPEND) and 'remove' (REMOVE).

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row contributes hashed identifier values (email/phone), grouped per type into separate uploaded files.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (custom_audience_id / action / files_uploaded / rows_submitted / rows_submitted_by_type / update_response). Matching can take 24-48h on TikTok's side.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

custom_audience_id.label: Custom Audience ID
custom_audience_id.description: Target TikTok Custom Audience ID. Must already exist.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> identifier type ('email' or 'phone'). Values are SHA-256 hashed before upload.

operation.label: Operation
operation.description: 'add' maps to TikTok action=APPEND; 'remove' maps to action=REMOVE.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: TikTok Custom Audience Upsert
